# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 90 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 90

Jesus said: "Come to me — my yoke is easy to carry and my authority over you is gentle — and you will find rest."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Easy to carry" — the yoke's lightness made physically concrete
- "My authority over you" — the lordship/mastery as relational authority
- "You will find rest" — the *anapausis* as the goal of the coming
